top_categories.workout_context: The Gravel of Marathon's Lake Marathon dirt, Rural dirt and farm roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 59 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic The Gravel of Marathon's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
73ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
When someone attacks on rocky climbs, rural dirt roads and repeated, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At The Gravel of Marathon, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At The Gravel of Marathon, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of The Gravel of Marathon. Train it until it feels boring.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on rocky climbs, rural dirt roads and repeated. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
59 miles on rocky climbs, rural dirt roads and repeated burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on rocky climbs, rural dirt roads and repeated demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Smooth pedaling at 59 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for The Gravel of Marathon’s 59 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at The Gravel of Marathon requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rocky climbs, rural dirt roads and repeated lakeside loops to build confidence. Expect: lake marathon dirt, rural dirt and farm roads, rocky opening climb.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 59 miles of rocky climbs, rural dirt roads and repeated lakeside loops in Marathon, Attica, Greece.
